page_title: NOT 1-0 MCI | Nottingham Forest v Manchester City 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Chris Kavanagh is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) sends a long ball in, but Matz Sels comfortably gathers the ball.
90+3' A quickly taken corner by Nottingham.
90+2' What a chance for Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) as he produced a stunning snap shot from the edge of the box! The goalkeeper was a bit lucky as the ball went just wide of the right post.
90+1' Manchester City quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Erling Haaland collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
90+1' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' A cross is whipped into the box by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) and Erling Haaland controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
87' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Callum Hudson-Odoi and he is replaced by Morato (Nottingham).
87' The referee signals a substitution. Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Chris Wood.
86' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
86' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Chris Wood (Nottingham), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
84' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
83' 1 - 0 Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the right side of the goal.
82' Chris Kavanagh blows the whistle, Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) is penalised for a foul.
80' Substitution. Anthony Elanga makes his way off the pitch and Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) comes on as his replacement.
80' Chris Wood (Nottingham) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
79' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
78' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his low effort is straight at Matz Sels.
77' A free kick on the edge of the box for Manchester City. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ryan Yates (Nottingham) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
75' The attendance for today's match is 30252.
72' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the left post.
69' A substitution has been made. Nicolas Dominguez goes off and Ryan Yates (Nottingham) comes on.
69' Substitution. Savinho walks off the pitch and Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) comes on as a substitute.
69' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Phil Foden is replaced by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).
69' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

67' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) got in a good shooting position on the edge of the box and pulled the trigger. The ball flew towards the right side of the goal, but Ederson punched it onto the post.
65' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
63' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
61' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) replaces Nico.
61' Matheus Nunes will be replaced by Rico Lewis (Manchester City).
60' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
59' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
56' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) has tested the patience of referee Chris Kavanagh and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
56' The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
56' Savinho (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
53' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) leaps to meet the corner, but fires his header back across goal from close in and it goes well wide of the left post.
52' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) will take a corner kick.
51' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
48' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the right side of the goal that is easily dealt with by Ederson.
46' The whistle blows and Chris Kavanagh starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Neco Williams (Nottingham) commits a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' The shot by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Matz Sels.
41' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
40' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) fires a volley from the edge of the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
38' The ball possession at the moment is 31:69.
37' It looks like Ola Aina (Nottingham) saw red with that tackle. Chris Kavanagh won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
35' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
34' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
32' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Nico (Manchester City) for his blatant foul.
31' He should have scored! Phil Foden (Manchester City) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
29' Phil Foden (Manchester City) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
27' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.
27' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ola Aina (Nottingham).
25' A precise low pass is received by Nico (Manchester City), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
25' Savinho (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
23' It could have been a good chance to score! Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) fails to release Phil Foden with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
21' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
20' Nico (Manchester City) makes a strong challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
17' Savinho (Manchester City) plays a through ball but overhits it.

14' That was absolutely fantastic! Nico (Manchester City) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the left post! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
12' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but Ederson comes off his line to gather the ball.
12' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Chris Kavanagh who sees an offensive foul.
10' Savinho (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
8' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post.
7' Savinho (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
6' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
3' The corner from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is hurriedly cleared.
2' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
1' A clumsy foul by Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle.
1' The first half has started.
Nottingham will kick the game off.
